needs_review.question_text_raw: Seventeen open problems concerning Φ-convex analysis are presented.

evidence.quote: Seventeen open problems concerning \((\Phi\)-convex analysis are presented.

These problems are connected with: – the classes of \((\Phi\)-convex functions for some special families \((\Phi\), – subdifferentials of \((\Phi\)-convex functions as monotone multifunctions, – uniqueness property, – \((\Phi\)-separated sets, – globalization (the problems when local notions are simultaneously global) for \((\Phi\)-convexity and -- \((\Phi\)-subgradients, – Lipschitz functions and Lipschitz multifunctions, – relations between duality and Lipschitz functions, – approximation of sets and decisively separated sets, – Fréchet \((\Phi\)-differentiability of Lipschitz functions and monotonicity property.
